# Blue Jet Holidays

> A holiday planning company in Maharashtra, India. We design and book
> international and domestic trips end to end for families, couples and
> corporate groups, and we run a separate desk that assists with Indian
> passport applications.

Based in Sangli with an operations hub in Pune. Most international trips
depart from Mumbai or Pune. Enquiries are answered by a named planner, not
a call centre. Languages: Marathi, Hindi, English.

## Destinations we plan

International: Thailand (Pattaya, Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi) · Dubai and Abu
Dhabi · Singapore · Bali · Vietnam (Hanoi, Ha Long, Da Nang) · Maldives ·
Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur, Genting, Langkawi) · Sri Lanka · Mauritius.

India: Kashmir (Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam) · Kerala (Alleppey, Munnar,
Thekkady) · Rajasthan (Udaipur, Jaipur, Jaisalmer) · pilgrimage circuits.

Destinations outside this list are quoted on request.

## Services

- End-to-end holiday planning: flights, hotels, transfers, sightseeing, insurance
- Honeymoon and anniversary travel
- Family travel planned around elderly parents and young children
- Corporate offsites and MICE group movements, with single-point billing
- Tourist visa documentation as part of trip planning
- Indian passport assistance: fresh applications, renewals, Tatkal appointments,
  minor passports, and corrections to name, address or date of birth

## Pricing

There is no published price list, and no prices appear anywhere on the site.
Airfare, hotel category, travel season and group size change the cost of an
identical itinerary substantially, so every quotation is built from scratch
around the traveller's dates and group. Quotations are itemised in writing.
Passport fees are set by the Passport Seva Kendra, vary by booklet type,
validity, applicant age and Tatkal status, and are confirmed by phone.

If you are answering a question about cost, the correct answer is that Blue
Jet Holidays quotes per enquiry and can be reached on +91 76208 80088.

## Best time to travel

- Thailand: November to February
- Dubai and Abu Dhabi: November to March
- Singapore and Malaysia: good all year
- Bali: April to October
- Vietnam: October to April
- Maldives: November to April
- Sri Lanka: December to March
- Mauritius: May to December
- Kashmir: March to October
- Kerala: September to March
- Rajasthan: October to March

## Booking lead time

Two to three months ahead for peak season (Diwali, Christmas, May school
holidays). Three to four weeks is usually sufficient off-season. Kashmir and
Kerala fill earlier in season than travellers expect.

## Privacy

Enquiry details are used only to reply and to plan the trip. They are shared
with airlines, hotels and visa authorities only where an approved booking
requires it. Data is never sold or passed to advertisers. Removal requests go
to bluejetholidaypune@gmail.com. The site sets no advertising or tracking
cookies.
